title: Structura Reditus Research Library — Author Record
description: Identity record for an author registered in the Research Library. Author identity is stable while contribution history changes. Credentials are provenance metadata with a verification state; they carry no numeric weight.

display_name.description: Public display name of the author.

orcid.description: ORCID iD, if supplied. Never fabricated.

status.description: Registry status of the author identity.

registered.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of first registration with an explicit time-zone designator (Z or +/-HH:MM). Date-only values are ambiguous and not accepted.

credentials.description: Optional provenance metadata. Credentials carry a verification state and no numeric weight. Never invented.

notes.description: Free-text explanatory notes. Supplements, never replaces, controlled fields.
